title: Optional self-verification after issuance
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 13. Reference script.

statements.label: Optional self-verification after issuance
statements.requirement: The issuer SHALL offer a policy flag that decodes and verifies every certificate it has just issued against the Signer's DSC before returning it. The flag SHOULD default to on in the testkit.

sources.quote: then decodes its own output and verifies the signature, so a failed run is a failed round trip rather than a silently broken certificate
